subject: SIG welcome checklist + a few scope clarifications
messages:
From: Tanya Singh <tanya.singh@helioshealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: security + questionnaire preference

Hi Lukas —

Thanks for the demo earlier today. It was helpful to see the dedicated deployment options and the latency numbers. Our security team is starting the vendor evaluation for a potential pilot and asked for a quick summary of Redwood's compliance posture and the preferred questionnaire format to get started. A few immediate asks from my side:  

- SOC 2: can you confirm whether Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report and the period covered?
- HIPAA/GDPR: do you have a BAA template and any notes on data residency for controlled health data?
- Questionnaire: we can accept SIG Lite, CAIQ, or a short custom questionnaire. Which do you recommend for initial prefill?

If you can send a prefilled SIG/CAIQ (or a template) and a short SOC2 summary, we can circulate internally. We aim to decide an onboarding path by next Thursday.

Also looping in Raj (it security) and procurement for timelines.

Thanks —
Tanya Singh
Head of IT Security
Helios Health

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Tanya Singh <tanya.singh@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security + questionnaire preference

Hi Tanya —

Really appreciate the quick follow-up and the clear asks. Recap + immediate plan below:  

Recap: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report (period: 2025-01 through 2025-12). We also have an internal HIPAA readiness program and a BAA template we can share. For data residency, we support per-customer region pinning for Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted defaults to US regions unless a private deployment is requested.

Questions so we can prefill accurately:  
- Which questionnaire do you want first: SIG Lite, full CAIQ, or a short custom form? If you'd like us to pick, we typically send a SIG Lite prefill first and offer the CAIQ on request.
- Scope: will the pilot process PII/PHI? If PHI, we'll include HIPAA-specific controls (and confirm BAA routing).
- Retention: are you primarily concerned about token retention in Hosted API or the underlying storage in Dedicated/Private?

Attachments I will include:  
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC2 snapshot + auditor and controls scope)
- sig-prefill-template.xlsx (SIG Lite prefill template we can fill in)

Next steps I propose:  
1) I prefill a SIG Lite draft and send it back for your review by EOD tomorrow.
2) Kimberly (cc'd) will pick up the CAIQ if you prefer a deeper technical pass.
3) If PHI is in scope, we can route a BAA and an architecture call with an engineer.

If that sounds good I'll start the SIG prefill now. Also propose a 30-minute call Friday morning to walk through answers — what time works for your team?

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf] [attachment: sig-prefill-template.xlsx]

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@helioshealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Tanya Singh <tanya.singh@helioshealth.com>
Cc: procurement@helioshealth.com
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security + questionnaire preference

Lukas —

Thanks for the quick recap and for offering the SIG prefill. A few clarifications from our side so your prefill matches the in-scope controls:  

- Pilot data will include PHI (limited to clinical notes and appointment metadata). We will need a BAA; procurement is cc'd.
- Residency: pilot must be in a US region only.
- Retention concern: primarily token retention for hosted inference, and whether developer logs contain user text. We need concrete statements about automatic log retention and an option to disable logging for PII/PHI.

On questionnaire preference: start with a SIG Lite prefill and then we'll ask for CAIQ where we need technical depth.

Also: can you confirm whether Redwood offers an option to run in our VPC (private deployment) for the pilot, and how long typical Private onboarding takes?

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, procurement@helioshealth.com
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security + questionnaire preference

Raj / Tanya —

Thanks — that's perfect context. Short answers and concrete next steps:  

1) SOC2: confirmed — SOC 2 Type II (reporting period 2025 calendar year). I'll attach the SOC2 snapshot (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) when I send the prefill.

2) BAA & PHI: we have a standard BAA and can execute with DocuSign. Link included below. For the pilot, Private deployment / VPC is supported; typical Private onboarding time is 4–6 weeks depending on infra approvals. For quicker pilots we can use Dedicated capacity with region pinning while the Private onboarding proceeds.

3) Logging & retention: Hosted API by default does not persist user text for customers with PHI when the "PII-safe" toggle is enabled; we offer explicit log-disable and token-retention policies for enterprise customers. I'll include the exact policy excerpt in the prefill.

4) Questionnaire flow: we'll prefill SIG Lite and mark any items that need CAIQ depth. Kimberly will pick up CAIQ follow-up items for deeper technical evidence.

Planned deliverables (action items):  
- I will send a SIG Lite prefill (sig-prefill-template.xlsx) and the SOC2 snapshot by EOD today.
- Kimberly will prepare CAIQ-related notes and will follow up Wednesday if needed.
- I'll share a DocuSign BAA link to procurement after you confirm pilot approach.

Links:  
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HL-2187
- BAA (DocuSign placeholder): https://docusign.com/BAA/HL-2187

Could you confirm whether procurement prefers the BAA routed to procurement@helioshealth.com or executed by Tanya directly? Also, what time works for a 30-min call this Friday (I have 9:30–11:30 PT open)?

Thanks —
